nrIncident.summary: No trains at Pevensey & Westham until approximately 08:00
nrIncident.message:
A power cut at Pevensey & Westham means that trains are unable to call at this station and will be revised to run non-stop between Pevensey Bay and Hampden Park.
Disruption is expected until 08:00.
Customer advice:
Pevensey & Westham will not be served until further notice, meaning trains are unable to call or depart from this station.
If you are travelling to or from Pevensey & Westham you will need to use an alternative route and will need to allow at least an extra 15 minutes to complete your journey. Please check station information boards and online journey planners for the latest information.
If you are at Pevensey & Westham:
If you are currently at Pevensey & Westham you will need to make your way to the nearest train station for further travel.
If you require assistance on further travel, please contact Southern online on X (Twitter)
If you are travelling to Pevensey & Westham:
You will need to take a Southern service to Eastbourne. At Eastbourne, please speak to station staff for further travel to Pevensey & Westham.
Planning your journey:
For help planning your journey, check live departure boards, view a live network map or see alternative route guides.
If you’re travelling within London, you can use the TfL Journey Planner.
Can you tell me more about the incident?
A power cut at Pevensey & Westham means that the station lights are not working. As the station is in darkness, it's not safe for trains to call.
Station teams and the local electricity suppliers are working to ensure that the station is returned to a mains electricity supply as quickly as possible.
Check before you travel:
You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.
Compensation:
You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.
